Tom — thanks for the clear note and the draft invoice. Quick responses below; copying Laura (Finance) and Kimberly (Tax/Compliance) so we can close this out.

1) Payment terms / credit cap
   - For pilots we usually offer Net45 as a standard compromise. Net60 is available but requires pre-approved credit (typically ~30 days for underwriting).
   - We can accept your proposed €60k provisional cap under Net45 for the 3-month pilot if Lighthouse provides either: (a) a refundable pilot deposit of €15k, or (b) a completed credit application + two months of on-time payments (auto-escalation to Net60 possible afterwards).

2) Invoicing & VAT
   - Redwood operates with a US HQ and an EU VAT entity (Redwood EU GmbH). We can issue invoices that: (i) include VAT, or (ii) omit VAT and include reverse-charge wording if you provide your EU VAT registration number and the VAT certificate.
   - Kimberly, can you confirm the exact reverse-charge line we should use on the invoice for Belgian clients?

3) Mechanics
   - Preferred payment methods: SEPA / Wire. ACH is US-only. If you go with the deposit route we will provide bank details and a short receipt. If you opt for credit application, Laura will run the underwriting.

Next steps: please confirm which of the two credit routes you prefer (deposit vs credit app) and attach the VAT registration doc if you want reverse-charge. I can produce an updated invoice and an amendment to the SOW reflecting Net45 pilot terms.

Best,
Aditya Rao
